title: Conlang Dictionary
description: Schema for defining a conlang dictionary file.

id.description: UUID of the language configuration this dictionary belongs to

entries.description: List of words in the dictionary

id.description: Base62 representation of a UUIDv7 identifier generated when the word is added

meaning.description: The meaning of the word represented as an IPA string

definition.description: The conlang word definition represented as an IPA string

era.description: A 32-bit unsigned number indicating the era of the word

etymology.description: An etymological history represented as a map of era number to list of source strings

usage_notes.description: Any additional usage notes or context
